name: DEBUG UV-Vis TD-DFT (HF/STO-3G, ~free)
template:
# DEBUG TD-DFT (really TD-HF/CIS at HF/STO-3G), 1 core. Produces an ABSORPTION
# SPECTRUM block to exercise the parser / UV-Vis plot for next to no compute. NOT
# for chemistry (no XC, minimal basis). Use a real PBE0/CAM-B3LYP recipe for science.

! HF STO-3G

%maxcore 1000

%pal nprocs 1
end

%tddft
  nroots 5
  maxdim 5
end
